behaviors.description: The calling agent selects get_weather with city Austin for a weather request.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: The agent trajectory on stdout names get_weather as its first tool call with city Austin.

directions.text: The standard output you obtained from the call weather tool command (with the supplied stdin prompt) is asserted to satisfy every declared condition together. The declared polarity expects this relation to hold. The calling agent command stdout trajectory. A trajectory whose first tool call is another tool or whose arguments name another city is treated as a defect.

safetyLimits: The calling agent makes no network call and executes no selected tool.
